# `admintrader`

Source: [`mods/admintrader`](https://github.com/aoughwl/aowlspt/blob/main/mods/admintrader).

## Settings

Defined in [`mods/admintrader/config.json`](https://github.com/aoughwl/aowlspt/blob/main/mods/admintrader/config.json). The values shown are the **shipped defaults**, not what is currently deployed.

### `enabled`

- **Default:** `true`

Add the Admin Trader to the game at backend start. Turning this off does not remove a trader already written into a running server's database -- restart the backend.

### `nickname`

- **Default:** `"Admin Trader"`

What the trader is called on the trading screen. This is the one setting that applies live: change it on the in-game settings page and the trader is renamed on the spot.

### `maxOffers`

- **Default:** `4500`

How many handbook items he stocks. The handbook holds about 4,300 tradeable items, so the default is effectively 'all of them'. Lower it if you want a shorter list to scroll.
